description: Operations-first dashboard for the DogeOS services and Scroll L2 Reth fleet, combining Kubernetes health, resource saturation, native application metrics, business frontiers, and logs without fabricating telemetry for uninstrumented binaries.

panels.title: Fleet health
panels.description: Kubernetes and log signals cover every deployed service, including binaries without an application metrics endpoint.

options.content:
### Runtime scope

This dashboard tracks the DogeOS application services plus all Scroll L2 Reth workloads:

- `tso-service`
- `withdrawal-processor`
- `l1-interface`
- `proof-coordinator`
- `eth-da-submitter`
- `cubesigner-signer`
- `fee-oracle-0`
- `dogecoin`
- `l2-reth-sequencer-0/1`
- `l2-reth-bootnode-0/1`
- `l2-reth-rpc` and `l2-reth-rpc-public`

**Native Prometheus:** TSO, withdrawal processor, L1 interface, ETH DA submitter, fee oracle, and Scroll L2 Reth.

**Exporter-backed:** Dogecoin.

**Kubernetes + Loki only:** proof coordinator and CubeSigner signer. Their current binaries expose no Prometheus endpoint, so this dashboard does not invent application metrics for them. Use the dedicated `reth` folder for rollup-node application metrics and node-to-node comparison.
